abstract: Configure the Vercel AI SDK (ai 7, @ai-sdk/*) against self-hosted OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints: vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, LiteLLM and llama-swap. Covers choosing createOpenAICompatible, createOpenAI or createAnthropic, base-URL shapes, key handling without printing secrets, model-name aliases with customProvider, structured output, tool calling, streaming and usage caveats, v6 to v7 changes, troubleshooting, and a curl and jq probe script.
